name: resize
description: Resize the pseudoconsole of a streaming child started by shell.spawn with `pty` (NexusStreamingProcess.Resize). Returns { found }: false for an unknown or exited stream; a pipe child (spawned without `pty`) answers found: true and nothing happens. cols and rows outside 1..1000 are INVALID_ARGS. Covered by the shell.spawn.pty primitive; an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
